name: How long does the sliding door replacement process typically take for an older home?

mainEntity.name: How long does the sliding door replacement process typically take for an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a sliding door replacement in an older home can vary. A standard single-door replacement typically takes one to two days for installation. However, the overall project timeline, from initial consultation and measurement to manufacturing and final installation, can range from 4 to 12 weeks. Factors like custom sizing, material availability, and any necessary structural modifications in older homes can extend this timeframe. We provide a detailed project schedule after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 1-2 days. The full process, from consultation to completion, can range from 4 to 12 weeks, depending on customization and structural needs.
